thread:
Zoe: FYI — NRT edge is seeing intermittent netlink flaps since 03:10 JST. Provisioning jobs to the pool are stalling, and our RMA handoff window for the H100 top-up looks at risk.
Ian: How widespread? per-region or single rack?
Zoe: Started at a leaf switch in nrt-rack-7, looks like packet drops to the provisioning API (10.10.7.*). Affects ~12 GPUs in the staging pool.
Maya: If provisioning stalls that long, we lose our spot in the vendor preflight queue. Arjun, any chance to hold the AWB or push a same-day pickup?
Arjun (NexaSupply): We can hold outbound from our end for 6 hrs max. Can also split into air+sea if customs window is narrow. AWB for current shipment: AWB-NX-983271.
Chen: Can we reroute those VMs to SGP Dedicated pool temporarily? Latency cost vs outage tradeoff.
Zoe: Short-term yes — but it'll spike unit cost ~30% and reduce throughput due to cross-region queueing.
Ian: How many requests are blocked vs degraded? numbers?
Zoe: ~220 provisioning attempts failed in 18m, 150 succeeded after retry, ~70 still queued.
Maya: Cost math — 70 stuck GPUs * expected 2hr startup * SGP uplift => rough incremental $3.2k if we N+1 to Dedicated. Worth it to avoid missing the RMA window?
Arjun (NexaSupply): If you confirm hold, we can delay pickup and consolidate into a single pallet to avoid repalletization charges. If we split (air for urgent 8 units + sea for rest) there's a $1.4k surcharge.
Ian: If we miss the vendor window we risk next available ETA being +7 business days. That's real customer risk.
Chen: Quick patch: flip routing policy for provisioning-api -> prefer s3-backed caching for KV cache priming so fewer long-running API calls. I can push a config change in 10m.
Zoe: That helps for new requests, not the already queued jobs. We need both: cache fallback + short detour to SGP for the stuck units.
OncallBot: ALERT: netlink-flap detected in nrt-rack-7 — 03:12 JST — ticket INC-2026-124 created.
Maya: Arjun, what paperwork/time for HS reclass if we split to sea? Customs could add 48-72h.
Arjun (NexaSupply): Sea split adds customs lead of 2–3 days in practice. Air-only avoids customs rework but costs more. We recommend: hold 6h while we confirm router fix; if not cleared, we do 8-unit air expedite and sea for remainder.
Ian: Can ops cover the 8-unit uplift if that prevents a 7-day slip? Ops budget or emergency charge?
Zoe: I can eat the emergency upcharge within QBR buffer up to $2k. After that we need approval from finance.
Maya: I'll prepare the brief for finance in case. Also need explicit acceptance from Platform SRE for the SGP detour.
Chen: Rolling the config now: switching to cache-primed routing and lowering batch windows for provisioning => reducing per-request tail latency. Pushing in 2m.
Zoe: Thanks. After Chen's push, we'll monitor for 10m. Arjun, please stand by to hold pickup until 09:20 JST, confirmed?
Arjun (NexaSupply): Confirmed hold until 09:20 JST. If we get sign-off to split at 09:20 we will execute air/sea split per the plan.
Ian: I'll open a short-lived SGP pool mapping and label the 70 stuck nodes to avoid double-alloc.
Maya: FYI finance contact: @Leah — looping in for potential emergency charge.
Zoe: Quick log snippet for manifest we pushed earlier:
```
manifest_id: MAN-2026-NRT-4732
carrier: NexaExpress
items: 24 x H100
scheduled_pickup: 2026-05-18T09:00:00+09:00
notes: hold-if-netlink-flap
```
Chen: Monitoring shows retries succeeded for ~50% after cache flip. Queue draining.
Zoe: If we continue to drain and Arjun can still hold, we avoid the split. Keep this thread updated.
Arjun (NexaSupply): Holding. Will confirm final AWB consolidation at 09:15 JST.
Maya: I'll draft the cost exception if we need air — ETA to Leah in 5.
Ian: I'll coordinate the SGP detour tags and ensure no double allocation.
Zoe: Closing loop: if last_message_ts > 1775550600 update here. For now — stay on watch. :eyes:
